That makes a lot of sense. When you're dealing with headaches and fatigue, adding the pressure of research can feel overwhelming, especially when you've already taken on a new major and a club.

Since your health is currently affecting your ability to focus, it might be worth reconsidering whether committing to the research right now is sustainable for you. You mentioned earlier that you don't want to miss out on something great, but sometimes pausing or delaying a commitment until you're feeling better is the best way to ensure you can actually contribute well later on.

Have you considered talking to your professor about this hesitation? She seemed supportive before, and she might understand if you need to prioritize your health over the research opportunity at this specific moment.
